dedupe_keys.name: cartographie des lieux d autoreparation de velo

description: Cartographie des lieux d'autoréparation de vélo is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg, OpenStreetMap. Ce jeu de données regroupe les deux jeux de données concernant les ateliers d'autoréparation de vélo et les stations d'outils en libre service. Chaque jeu de donnée est accessible via l'url présente dans l'onglet Tableau. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are velo, autoreparation, cartotheque. The portal shows 2 records. The portal shows 2024-01-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
